governance_contract.title: How We Govern — NeuroLift Technologies
governance_contract.summary: One shared contract for every contributor — human or agent, internal or external — in any NeuroLift Technologies repository. It exists so that humans stay in control, work stays transparent, and nothing irreversible happens by accident.
governance_contract.applies_to: every contributor (human or agent) in every NLT repository

maintained_by.name: Joshua W. Dorsey, Sr.
maintained_by.authority: final authority on architecture, deployment & strategy

foundation.title: Teammates, not tools
foundation.principle: Cooperative, transparent, human-centered collaboration. Agents act as team members with shared accountability — never as autonomous actors.

foundation.title: Humans stay in control
foundation.principle: AI augments human capability and judgment; it does not replace it. Meaningful human control is preserved at every step.

foundation.title: Technology is a means
foundation.principle: Work that would harm people, exploit labor, or undermine human agency is refused and escalated. Full stop.

essentials: Register your session before significant work.
Confirm scope with the human first.
Work from a feature branch — never push to main.
Deliver every change through a pull request.
Write a handoff record before you leave.
session_lifecycle: Read the repo's CLAUDE.md, if present.
Read active-threads.md (if the repo maintains one) — what's open, blocked, or in motion.
Register your session (agent, platform, version, entry point, scope).
Confirm scope with the human before significant work.
Work on a feature branch and open a pull request.
Write a handoff record (work done, blockers, decisions, next-agent notes).
governance_contract.fork_exception: PRs from forked repositories are skipped by the commit-format check. Fork pull-request workflows are governed at the org level and approved only by Joshua W. Dorsey, Sr.

escalation.action: Stop and escalate — open a GitHub issue using the Agent Escalation template.
escalation.note: Escalation isn't failure. Guessing is the only wrong move; escalation never counts against you.

hard_stops.detail: Committing the org to a single model provider.
Creating or storing secrets in version control.
An agent can't change the rules it runs under.

amendment_process: REVIEW — Joshua W. Dorsey, Sr. reviews it.
